notes: Four taḥwīl branches; the names written after the last «قالا» (here «قالا أخبرنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا معمر» belongs to branch four only) are its own, so the shared tail is «كلهم عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد»
The fifth group is a remark on another narration: «رواية الليث عن محمد بن النعمان» carries different transmitters for the story of Bashir and Nu'man; stored as a variant, not a route
The wording remarks («أكل بنيك», «أكل ولدك») are left out. Ishaq b. Ibrahim appears twice in the text (occurrences 1 and 2)
